## 2. Build cache: one agent run's build sequence

### build/bench/c10_dds_sine (small: 1.2k LUT)

| call | until | cache | wall s (measured, with cache) | wall s without cache (modelled) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | synth | fresh | 117.7 | 115.5 |
| 2 | synth | hit | 0.4 | 115.5 |
| 3 | route | resume_synth | 105.7 | 199.3 |
| 4 | route | hit | 0.5 | 199.3 |
| 5 | route | hit | 0.5 | 199.3 |
| 6 | route | hit | 0.5 | 199.3 |
| 7 | bitstream | resume_route | 79.3 | 238.7 |
| total | | | **304.6** | **1266.9** |

Saved: 962.3 s of 1266.9 s (76%). The final (resumed) build's placement/routing hashes and WNS match the fresh 4-thread build c10_t4_a (('c92da15b2a81', 'ea4ea1781c99') vs ('c92da15b2a81', 'ea4ea1781c99'), WNS 3.245 vs 3.245). Gates of the final build: pass.

Model: a fresh build stopped at synth costs the fresh full build's time to `synth_reports` plus its start-up and runner overhead (8.1 s: wall time minus the last stage timestamp); stopped at route, its time to `reports` plus the same; to the bitstream, its measured wall time.
